contract.intent: Implement the 0.4.0 modular SDLC engine with explicit capability boundaries, deterministic phase execution, provenance-bound artifacts, and replaceable real-execution adapters with measured assurance.

outcomes.statement: The package typechecks, tests, builds, and packs as @agentskit/harness 0.3.0.
The real CLI is runnable and exposes both ak-harness and ak-verify.
Repository governance and release documentation are complete and internally consistent.
Issue/worktree claims and dispatch records are atomic, idempotent, and human-recoverable.
Retryable quota/timeout failures use bounded recovery while policy and validation failures fail closed.
Changed-file preflight selects narrow checks and rejects shell-composed dispatch commands.
Adversarial review, PR content approval, publication gates, and QA transition decisions are deterministic and hash-bound.
Phase telemetry and quality matrices report bounded 0-100 scores, honest unknowns, baseline deltas, and classified watchdog blockers.
Portable block, status, retro/learning, model-policy, and machine-policy records validate deterministically.
Coding-agent, Orca, Doc Bridge, memory, cache, runtime, and tracking adapters expose provider-neutral contracts with explicit assurance, telemetry, bounded failures, and idempotent dry-run behavior.
Capability modules are organized under explicit boundaries and forbidden kernel/provider imports fail deterministically.
Phase profiles declare inputs, outputs, dependencies, gates, bounded retries, budgets, effects, and deterministic pass/block/escalate/retry/cancel/resume routing.
Versioned artifacts bind run provenance, render as JSON and Markdown, record decisions in the event log, reject stale bindings, and resume completed phases without replaying handlers.
